headline: desired_capacity=1 is below min_size=3; AWS will reject or immediately override this, so the scaling change will never take effect

findings.evidence_ref: compute.tf: desired_capacity changed from 3 to 1 while min_size remains 3
findings.explanation: AWS requires min_size ≤ desired_capacity ≤ max_size. Setting desired_capacity to 1 with min_size of 3 is an invalid configuration; AWS will either reject the API call or immediately raise desired_capacity back to 3, so the intended cost saving will not happen.
